scope: Bound buyer-strength and trade-off proposal for exactly 24 integrated Australian truck configurations, using final effective fact/source/identity/availability guards; no application writes.

countingPolicy.fuso: 14 factory chassis codes, with 10 optional downratings retained as options inside those records
countingPolicy.hyundai: One 7,300 kg bare cab chassis; lower 4,495/4,500 kg conflict and body options do not add records
countingPolicy.farizon: Three F3E named bodies plus four named H9E brochure columns; no invented body/battery combinations
countingPolicy.foton: Two current-linked T5 published GVM configurations; stock/equipment epoch unverified

measurementCohorts.vehicleClass: truck only; do not rank with passenger cars or vans
measurementCohorts.mass: Exact rating minus corresponding bare-chassis mass only. Estimated masses remain estimated. Published completed-body figures retain their stated and unknown treatment of occupants/accessories.
measurementCohorts.range: No normalized cross-cycle comparison. Only F3E Tray/Cargo Box declared WLTP comparison is used in lead copy; test payload unspecified. JAC C-WTVC, Hyundai local loaded-tray test and Foton unspecified-cycle claims are separate.
measurementCohorts.battery: Declared capacity only; no usable/gross conversion or battery-to-range calculation.
measurementCohorts.dimensions: Only corresponding labelled wheelbase, cab-chassis length, body height and kerb-to-kerb diameter. No generic overall width or swept-path inference.
measurementCohorts.charging: Vehicle maximum kW distinct from station rating, cable rating and charge-time SOC window.

bindingRequirements: This is the bound SellingPointProposal shape. Merge records by variantId, dependencies by id and expectedSourceSnapshots by source id; do not replace unrelated rows.
Use the validated selling-points.ts optional expectedEffectiveFact, expectedSourceSnapshots, expectedIdentity, expectedAvailabilityEvidence, related-configuration and availability-source guards.
Keep every requiredVisibleConditions entry visible with either clause. Context dependencies guard both clauses; source-less unknowns remain audit-only.
Preserve truck-only measurement cohorts and existing ranking holds; current listed_unconfirmed does not establish stock or delivery.
If the effective snapshot changes, rebind and rerun validation rather than updating dates or expected values without source review.

visualReview.finding: Charger compatibility row: at least 569.4 V, 400 V infrastructure incompatible; 502 V battery remains a separate value.
Weight columns visibly repeat 4,050 kg across ratings and bodies. Only 7,300 minus 3,250 bare-chassis allowance used; no repeated pantech/low-GVM payload accepted.
Exact A/B/C codes, dimensions, turning and mass columns read visually.
Exact single code, 12 m turning and 2,745 kg estimated chassis mass read visually; disputed seat wording is not used.
Exact City Cab sheet confirms 22 kW AC and 104 kW DC maxima; no SOC window specified.
6,000/4,495 kg rating and 3,070 kg mass read visually.
22 kW AC and 104 kW DC maxima; charge times explicitly theoretical with no SOC window.
A/B columns distinguished: B long wheelbase explicitly 89 km/h, not A 100 km/h.
Standard/optional ratings and exact A/B estimated masses read visually.
Exact A/B/C code, mass, length and turning columns read visually.
Three packs/124 kWh rounded PDF capacity; no gross/usable claim.
4,450/4,750 mm columns and 3,960/3,975 kg estimated masses support like-wheelbase allowance comparison.
Visual audit: Cab Chassis range dash; Tray 314 km WLTP/1,440 kg; Cargo Box 250 km WLTP/1,190 kg/11.92 m3. Two seats, 90 km/h and 3.3 kW 240 V V2L across exact columns.
PDF page 8, not page 3. Four exact columns; Cargo Box 3,600 mm height; 8T 3,360/4,500 mm WB, 107/162 kWh; AC omission is not no-AC proof.
Raster 2025 Production table visibly confirms 4,495/6,000 kg GVM, 2,400 kg cab-chassis, 11 kW AC/85 kW DC and 90 km/h. 22 kW cable is separate.
Read-only exclusion audit: hidden extracted draft model codes and AC marks differ from render. All six historical JAC records remain excluded.

deliberatelyNotClaimed: No market-best, cheapest, best-in-class or recommendation ranking claim.
No licence eligibility, current transaction price, guaranteed order acceptance or delivery date.
No cargo fit or completed-body payload inferred from GVM, chassis allowance or volume.
No towing inferred from GCM and no trailer capability claim in lead copy.
No unknown SOC window invented; no sustained peak-charge or charging-time superiority claim.
No battery energy labelled usable/gross without source support; no true range advantage inferred from capacity.
No JAC hidden draft values and no historical/future family records added to the current 24-record set.

sourceStageBindingRequirements: Do not feed this source-level schema directly to buildBuyerSummaries: sourceRecordId values are not final application variant IDs.

After integration, bind to the final effective pack() fact/feature rows, including value, status, unit, basis, comparison cohort, scope, conditions, source IDs and dates; do not bind merely to raw JSON rows.
Bind exact chassis/body/rating/technical epoch and model-year wording separately; no formal MY is inferred from brochure or file dates.
Preserve availability status/revision and visible exact-stock uncertainty. Family-level new stock must not promote an exact current-epoch record to verified in-stock.

All factual dependencies of comparisons include both exact configurations, with arithmetic recorded. Context dependencies preserve unknowns/conflicts as restrictions, never as proof a feature is absent.
If any fact used in either clause is missing, changes, conflicts or loses its qualifying conditions/source support, fail closed for that clause rather than filling gaps from family siblings.
Unresolved context such as H9E AC power remains visible; do not invent a positive/negative capability merely to fit runtime guards.

Run mutation tests for fact values, source IDs/date/access/conflicts, rating, body, technical epoch and comparison partner; verify each of 24 records has exactly one visible strength and tradeoff only when supported.
